nodes.author: Nautankei
nodes.text: @SyedAkbarHYD Traffic congestion is a major issue in Hyderabad, as narrow roads and rapid urbanization cause long commutes. Encroachments worsen the problem, especially during peak hours, making travel challenging and highlighting the city's struggle to adapt to growing demands. @hydcitypolice

nodes.author: Nautankei
nodes.text: @SyedAkbarHYD There are few citizens who feel that they can reach their destination faster by using the "Wrong side" logic. What empowers them to use such logic? Request @hydcitypolice @CPHydCity to punish such offenders for posing threats to lives of others.

nodes.text:
@SyedAkbarHYD Dear @hydcitypolice
Look at the menace of traffic created by #autorikshaw at #Hyderabad Station. No traffic personnel deployed to control traffic. Auto Rikshaw stand at the Bus Stop due to this Bus has to stand on main road resulting in traffic. It’s a daily routine.
